actualRuntimeReads.source:
<?php
class Inner {public $options=['mode'=>'inner'];}
class Config {public $options=['mode'=>'lower'];public $Options=['upper'=>'upper'];public $inner;public $items;
function __construct(){$this->inner=new Inner();$this->items=[new Inner()];}
function getInner(){return $this->inner;}}
$c=new Config();
set_error_handler(function($severity,$message){throw new Exception($message);});
$cases=[
'exact'=>function()use($c){return $c->options['mode'];},
'distinct'=>function()use($c){return $c->Options['upper'];},
'wrong'=>function()use($c){return $c->OPTIONS['mode'];},
'nested'=>function()use($c){return $c->inner->options['mode'];},
'wrong intermediate'=>function()use($c){return $c->INNER->options['mode'];},
'wrong final'=>function()use($c){return $c->inner->OPTIONS['mode'];},
'method case'=>function()use($c){return $c->GETINNER()->options['mode'];},
'foreach'=>function()use($c){foreach($c->items as $item)return $item->options['mode'];},
'wrong foreach'=>function()use($c){foreach($c->ITEMS as $item)return $item->options['mode'];}];
$result=[];foreach($cases as $name=>$read){try{$result[$name]=['value'=>$read()];}catch(Throwable $error){$result[$name]=['rejected'=>true];}}
foreach($result as $name=>$item)echo $name."=".(isset($item['rejected'])?'rejected':$item['value'])."\n";
